about_short_description.short_description: Quadrant Eye is breaking new ground in online eyecare.

product.name: At-Home Eye Health Screening
product.description: A service where licensed ophthalmic professionals visit your home to perform vision tests and collect eye health metrics, including visual acuity, pupillary response, and intraocular pressure.

product.name: Telehealth Services
product.description: A platform that allows individuals to receive eye care services, including assessment, treatment, diagnosis, and education, using interactive audio, video, and data communications.

product.name: Eye Health Screening with Insurance
product.description: An eye health screening service covered by insurance, including a comprehensive eye health report and a money-back guarantee, with a maximum copay of $35.

product.name: Eye Health Screening without Insurance
product.description: An eye health screening service for those without insurance, including a comprehensive eye health report and a money-back guarantee, with a maximum out-of-pocket cost of $50.
